paragraphs.en: OpenCode 2.0 is a major over haul. It draws on mil lions of daily users' expe ri ence to deliver a system that can flex to every thing an agent needs to be. There are quite a lot of new fea tures, per for mance improve ments, and bug fixes but here are some of the more impact ful user-facing changes.
paragraphs.zh: OpenCode 2.0 是一次重大的全面革新。 它汲取了数百万日活用户的使用经验，打造出一个能够灵活适应智能体一切需求的系统。 新功能、性能改进和错误修复相当多，这里列出的是一些对用户影响较大的变化。

sents.en: OpenCode 2.0 is a major over haul.
sents.zh: OpenCode 2.0 是一次重大的全面革新。

sents.en: It draws on mil lions of daily users' expe ri ence to deliver a system that can flex to every thing an agent needs to be.
sents.zh: 它汲取了数百万日活用户的使用经验，打造出一个能够灵活适应智能体一切需求的系统。

sents.en: There are quite a lot of new fea tures, per for mance improve ments, and bug fixes but here are some of the more impact ful user-facing changes.
sents.zh: 新功能、性能改进和错误修复相当多，这里列出的是一些对用户影响较大的变化。

paragraphs.en: From the begin ning OpenCode adopted a client/server model. However, this was not some thing it took advan tage of by default and was mostly used by power users.
paragraphs.zh: OpenCode 从一开始就采用了客户端/服务器模型。 然而，默认情况下它并没有利用这一特性，主要是高级用户在使用它。

sents.en: From the begin ning OpenCode adopted a client/server model.
sents.zh: OpenCode 从一开始就采用了客户端/服务器模型。

sents.en: However, this was not some thing it took advan tage of by default and was mostly used by power users.
sents.zh: 然而，默认情况下它并没有利用这一特性，主要是高级用户在使用它。

paragraphs.en: In 2.0 this server now auto mat i cally runs as a single back ground process on your machine. When you open up a TUI, the web inter face or the desktop app they're all talking to the same central process.
paragraphs.zh: 在 2.0 中，此服务现在会作为单个后台进程在你的机器上自动运行。 当你打开 TUI、网页界面或桌面应用时，它们都在与同一个中央进程通信。

sents.en: In 2.0 this server now auto mat i cally runs as a single back ground process on your machine.
sents.zh: 在 2.0 中，此服务现在会作为单个后台进程在你的机器上自动运行。

sents.en: When you open up a TUI, the web inter face or the desktop app they're all talking to the same central process.
sents.zh: 当你打开 TUI、网页界面或桌面应用时，它们都在与同一个中央进程通信。

paragraphs.en: If you're using the pro gram matic client @opencode/client to make your own scripts, they will autodis cover the local service and just work. This is par tic u larly useful for sched uled tasks. You can also call it via CLI by using opencode api com mands.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你使用编程客户端 @opencode/client 来编写自己的脚本，它们会自动发现本地服务并直接工作。 这对定时任务尤其有用。 你也可以通过 CLI 使用 opencode api 命令来调用它。

sents.en: If you're using the pro gram matic client @opencode/client to make your own scripts, they will autodis cover the local service and just work.
sents.zh: 如果你使用编程客户端 @opencode/client 来编写自己的脚本，它们会自动发现本地服务并直接工作。

sents.en: This is par tic u larly useful for sched uled tasks.
sents.zh: 这对定时任务尤其有用。

sents.en: You can also call it via CLI by using opencode api com mands.
sents.zh: 你也可以通过 CLI 使用 opencode api 命令来调用它。

paragraphs.en: You can expose it to other hosts and run /pair or opencode pair to connect it to other appli ca tions. We have native apps in the works that take advan tage of this flow.
paragraphs.zh: 你可以将它暴露给其他主机，并运行 /pair 或 opencode pair 来把它连接到其他应用程序。 我们正在开发能够利用此流程的原生应用。

sents.en: You can expose it to other hosts and run /pair or opencode pair to connect it to other appli ca tions.
sents.zh: 你可以将它暴露给其他主机，并运行 /pair 或 opencode pair 来把它连接到其他应用程序。

sents.en: We have native apps in the works that take advan tage of this flow.
sents.zh: 我们正在开发能够利用此流程的原生应用。

paragraphs.en: The old API grew hap haz ardly as we and the world col lec tively learned what agents are and should be. It was bad.
paragraphs.zh: 旧 API 在我们和整个世界共同探索智能体是什么、应该是什么的过程中随意生长。它很糟糕。

paragraphs.en: We started from scratch and exam ined all the weird use cases across the mil lions of users who use OpenCode every day. It now sup ports nearly any thing you need to be able to do.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从零开始，考察了每天使用 OpenCode 的数百万用户中所有奇怪的使用场景。 它现在几乎支持你需要做的任何事情。

sents.en: We started from scratch and exam ined all the weird use cases across the mil lions of users who use OpenCode every day.
sents.zh: 我们从零开始，考察了每天使用 OpenCode 的数百万用户中所有奇怪的使用场景。

sents.en: It now sup ports nearly any thing you need to be able to do.
sents.zh: 它现在几乎支持你需要做的任何事情。

paragraphs.en: OpenCode is also aware of its own API and will call it to do useful things like moving the current session into a git work tree when start ing new work.
paragraphs.zh: OpenCode 也能感知自身的 API，并会调用它来执行一些有用的操作，例如在开始新工作时将当前会话移动到 git work tree 中。

paragraphs.en: We've also shipped a new client package @opencode/client that con tains clients for vanilla JavaScript as well as Effect.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还发布了一个新的客户端包 @opencode/client，其中包含适用于原生 JavaScript 以及 Effect 的客户端。

paragraphs.en: import { OpenCode } from "@opencode/client" import { Service } from "@opencode/client/service" const endpoint = await Service. ensure () const client = OpenCode. make ({ baseUrl: endpoint.url, headers: Service. headers (endpoint), }) const session = await client.session. create ({ location: { directory: process. cwd () }, }) await client.session. prompt ({ sessionID: session.id, text: "Review the current changes" , }) Code Mode The models love to write code and OpenCode 2.0 takes advan tage of that more than any other coding agent. We've built a minimal JavaScript inter preter in the @opencode/codemode package.
paragraphs.zh: import { OpenCode } from "@opencode/client" import { Service } from "@opencode/client/service" const endpoint = await Service.ensure() const client = OpenCode.make({ baseUrl: endpoint.url, headers: Service.headers(endpoint), }) const session = await client.session.create({ location: { directory: process.cwd() }, }) await client.session.prompt({ sessionID: session.id, text: "Review the current changes", }) 代码模式 大模型酷爱写代码，而 OpenCode 2.0 比任何其他编码智能体都更充分地利用了这一点。 我们在 @opencode/codemode 包中构建了一个极简的 JavaScript 解释器。

sents.en: We've built a minimal JavaScript inter preter in the @opencode/codemode package.
sents.zh: 我们在 @opencode/codemode 包中构建了一个极简的 JavaScript 解释器。

paragraphs.en: This package ingests MCP servers or OpenAPI end points, con vert ing them into func tions that the agent can call in a script. It can run these scripts natively without the com plex ity of Node.js VMs or embed ding com pli cated solu tions like QuickJS.
paragraphs.zh: 该数据包可接入 MCP 服务器或 OpenAPI 端点，将其转换为智能体可在脚本中调用的函数。 它可以原生运行这些脚本，无需 Node.js 虚拟机那样的复杂机制，也无需嵌入 QuickJS 这类复杂的解决方案。

sents.en: This package ingests MCP servers or OpenAPI end points, con vert ing them into func tions that the agent can call in a script.
sents.zh: 该数据包可接入 MCP 服务器或 OpenAPI 端点，将其转换为智能体可在脚本中调用的函数。

sents.en: It can run these scripts natively without the com plex ity of Node.js VMs or embed ding com pli cated solu tions like QuickJS.
sents.zh: 它可以原生运行这些脚本，无需 Node.js 虚拟机那样的复杂机制，也无需嵌入 QuickJS 这类复杂的解决方案。

paragraphs.en: This lets your agent write scripts that can do things like call a tool, map over the results and call another tool. Single round trip instead of calling them one at a time.
paragraphs.zh: 这让你的智能体能够编写脚本，实现诸如调用一个工具、对结果进行映射并调用另一个工具之类的操作。 单次往返即可完成，而不用逐个调用。

sents.en: This lets your agent write scripts that can do things like call a tool, map over the results and call another tool.
sents.zh: 这让你的智能体能够编写脚本，实现诸如调用一个工具、对结果进行映射并调用另一个工具之类的操作。

sents.en: Single round trip instead of calling them one at a time.
sents.zh: 单次往返即可完成，而不用逐个调用。

paragraphs.en: All MCP servers in 2.0 are opted into code mode by default. This means you can add a thou sand of them with minimal context bloat and your agent will dis cover and compose them to get things done.
paragraphs.zh: 2.0 中的所有 MCP 服务器默认均已加入代码模式。 这意味着你可以添加上千个 MCP 服务器而几乎不会造成上下文膨胀，你的智能体将发现并组合它们来完成任务。

sents.en: All MCP servers in 2.0 are opted into code mode by default.
sents.zh: 2.0 中的所有 MCP 服务器默认均已加入代码模式。

sents.en: This means you can add a thou sand of them with minimal context bloat and your agent will dis cover and compose them to get things done.
sents.zh: 这意味着你可以添加上千个 MCP 服务器而几乎不会造成上下文膨胀，你的智能体将发现并组合它们来完成任务。

paragraphs.en: The latest batch of models are incred i bly good at orches tra tion and it is impor tant for har nesses to let them express the full extent of that capa bil ity.
paragraphs.zh: 最新一批模型在编排调度方面表现出色，因此「马具」（harness）让它们充分发挥这一能力至关重要。

paragraphs.en: First, we've added back ground sub agents. This allows the primary agent to kick off some work to another one while it con tin ues.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，我们添加回了后台子智能体。 这使得主智能体可以在继续自身工作的同时，把一些工作交给另一个智能体去执行。

sents.en: First, we've added back ground sub agents.
sents.zh: 首先，我们添加回了后台子智能体。

sents.en: This allows the primary agent to kick off some work to another one while it con tin ues.
sents.zh: 这使得主智能体可以在继续自身工作的同时，把一些工作交给另一个智能体去执行。

paragraphs.en: This happens auto mat i cally but you can also trigger it man u ally - even with a dif fer ent model. It lets you do things like “spawn a back ground fable sub agent to review this code” while you keep prompt ing.
paragraphs.zh: 这会自动发生，但你也可以手动触发——甚至可以使用不同的模型。 它让你可以在继续提示的同时执行诸如「生成一个后台 fable 子智能体来审查这段代码」之类的操作。

sents.en: This happens auto mat i cally but you can also trigger it man u ally - even with a dif fer ent model.
sents.zh: 这会自动发生，但你也可以手动触发——甚至可以使用不同的模型。

sents.en: It lets you do things like “spawn a back ground fable sub agent to review this code” while you keep prompt ing.
sents.zh: 它让你可以在继续提示的同时执行诸如「生成一个后台 fable 子智能体来审查这段代码」之类的操作。

paragraphs.en: Second, we've added back ground shell com mands. The shell tool can be invoked asyn chronously so long-running work does not have to block the primary agent. It'll be noti fied when things are com plete.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，我们加回了后台 shell 命令。 shell 工具可以异步调用，因此长时间运行的工作不必阻塞主智能体。 当任务完成时，它会收到通知。

sents.en: Second, we've added back ground shell com mands.
sents.zh: 其次，我们加回了后台 shell 命令。

sents.en: The shell tool can be invoked asyn chronously so long-running work does not have to block the primary agent.
sents.zh: shell 工具可以异步调用，因此长时间运行的工作不必阻塞主智能体。

sents.en: It'll be noti fied when things are com plete.
sents.zh: 当任务完成时，它会收到通知。

paragraphs.en: If any fore ground shell command or sub agent takes longer than you expect, you can hit a hotkey to move them to the back ground so you can keep prompt ing.
paragraphs.zh: 如果任何前台 shell 命令或子智能体所花费的时间超出预期，你可以按一个快捷键将它们移到后台，以便继续提示。

paragraphs.en: Although OpenCode 1.0 had a plugin system, it never got the atten tion it needed. To correct that, we forced our selves to imple ment nearly every OpenCode 2.0 feature as an inter nal plugin and there are now 80+ of them. This guar an tees that the Plugin API stays well main tained.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 OpenCode 1.0 已有插件系统，但它从未得到应有的关注。 为了纠正这一点，我们强制自己把几乎每个 OpenCode 2.0 功能都实现为内部插件，如今这些插件已有 80 多个。 这保证了插件 API 始终得到良好维护。

sents.en: Although OpenCode 1.0 had a plugin system, it never got the atten tion it needed.
sents.zh: 尽管 OpenCode 1.0 已有插件系统，但它从未得到应有的关注。

sents.en: To correct that, we forced our selves to imple ment nearly every OpenCode 2.0 feature as an inter nal plugin and there are now 80+ of them.
sents.zh: 为了纠正这一点，我们强制自己把几乎每个 OpenCode 2.0 功能都实现为内部插件，如今这些插件已有 80 多个。

sents.en: This guar an tees that the Plugin API stays well main tained.
sents.zh: 这保证了插件 API 始终得到良好维护。

paragraphs.en: We've also pro moted TUI plugins from exper i men tal to stable. Since it is all powered by OpenTUI, you can build nearly any thing. Here is an example of some thing useless.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还将 TUI 插件从实验阶段提升到了稳定阶段。 由于这一切都由 OpenTUI 驱动，你几乎可以构建任何东西。 下面是一个没什么用处的东西的例子。

sents.en: We've also pro moted TUI plugins from exper i men tal to stable.
sents.zh: 我们还将 TUI 插件从实验阶段提升到了稳定阶段。

sents.en: Since it is all powered by OpenTUI, you can build nearly any thing.
sents.zh: 由于这一切都由 OpenTUI 驱动，你几乎可以构建任何东西。

sents.en: Here is an example of some thing useless.
sents.zh: 下面是一个没什么用处的东西的例子。

paragraphs.en: We also spent quite a lot of time ensuring everything in OpenCode 2.0 can be hot-reloaded. So it can write a plugin for itself mid-session and use it right away - we covered the design of this in a previous blogpost .
paragraphs.zh: 我们还花了大量时间确保 OpenCode 2.0 中的所有内容都支持热重载。 因此它可以在会话进行中为自己编写插件并立即使用——我们在之前的一篇博客文章中介绍过这一设计。

sents.en: We also spent quite a lot of time ensuring everything in OpenCode 2.0 can be hot-reloaded.
sents.zh: 我们还花了大量时间确保 OpenCode 2.0 中的所有内容都支持热重载。

sents.en: So it can write a plugin for itself mid-session and use it right away - we covered the design of this in a previous blogpost .
sents.zh: 因此它可以在会话进行中为自己编写插件并立即使用——我们在之前的一篇博客文章中介绍过这一设计。

paragraphs.en: You can ask OpenCode to build whatever plugin you want and it knows how to. But if you do want to read the docs, they are available here .
paragraphs.zh: 你可以让 OpenCode 构建你想要的任何插件，它知道该怎么做。 但如果你确实想阅读文档，可以在这里查看。

sents.en: You can ask OpenCode to build whatever plugin you want and it knows how to.
sents.zh: 你可以让 OpenCode 构建你想要的任何插件，它知道该怎么做。

sents.en: But if you do want to read the docs, they are available here .
sents.zh: 但如果你确实想阅读文档，可以在这里查看。

paragraphs.en: OpenCode can also now be used as a library with the @opencode/sdk package. This is the exact same code that powers our CLI.
paragraphs.zh: OpenCode 现在还可以通过 @opencode/sdk 包作为库来使用。 这与驱动我们 CLI 的代码完全相同。

sents.en: OpenCode can also now be used as a library with the @opencode/sdk package.
sents.zh: OpenCode 现在还可以通过 @opencode/sdk 包作为库来使用。

sents.en: This is the exact same code that powers our CLI.
sents.zh: 这与驱动我们 CLI 的代码完全相同。

paragraphs.en: This means you can strip it down and make your own flavor of OpenCode that runs on a server or in spe cial ized envi ron ments like Durable Objects. And then you can connect to it from any OpenCode client since it speaks the stan dard OpenCode server pro to col.
paragraphs.zh: 这意味着你可以把它精简下来，打造你自己的 OpenCode 变体，让它运行在服务器上或 Durable Objects 等专用环境中。 然后你可以从任何 OpenCode 客户端连接到它，因为它使用标准的 OpenCode 服务器协议。

sents.en: This means you can strip it down and make your own flavor of OpenCode that runs on a server or in spe cial ized envi ron ments like Durable Objects.
sents.zh: 这意味着你可以把它精简下来，打造你自己的 OpenCode 变体，让它运行在服务器上或 Durable Objects 等专用环境中。

sents.en: And then you can connect to it from any OpenCode client since it speaks the stan dard OpenCode server pro to col.
sents.zh: 然后你可以从任何 OpenCode 客户端连接到它，因为它使用标准的 OpenCode 服务器协议。

paragraphs.en: It also has an optional Effect-based API.
paragraphs.zh: 它还提供一个可选的基于 Effect 的 API。

paragraphs.en: This one is still in development as things are shifting but you can already use it .
paragraphs.zh: 这个功能仍在开发中，因为相关内容还在变动，但你现在已经可以使用了。

paragraphs.en: To upgrade the CLI, make sure you're on the latest 1.x release, then run opencode upgrade --major .
paragraphs.zh: 要升级 CLI，请确保您使用的是最新的 1.x 版本，然后运行 opencode upgrade --major。

paragraphs.en: To upgrade your desktop app, download the latest here .
paragraphs.zh: 要升级您的桌面应用，请在此处下载最新版本。

paragraphs.en: There are a lot of other changes but they are backwards compatible. It is worth pointing OpenCode at this doc so it can migrate things for you.
paragraphs.zh: 还有很多其他改动，但它们都是向后兼容的。 值得让 OpenCode 阅读这份文档，以便它为你完成迁移工作。

sents.en: There are a lot of other changes but they are backwards compatible.
sents.zh: 还有很多其他改动，但它们都是向后兼容的。

sents.en: It is worth pointing OpenCode at this doc so it can migrate things for you.
sents.zh: 值得让 OpenCode 阅读这份文档，以便它为你完成迁移工作。
